accepted.s: The term “Adi” in the Adi-Andhra and Adi-Hindu movements signified which of the following?
accepted.x: “Adi” means original inhabitants. The movements rejected the term “Panchama” and sought a more dignified identity for Dalit communities.
accepted.tq: Directly identify the exact meaning of a movement-related term.
accepted.sec: Adi-Andhra and Adi-Hindu movements - sessions, venues, leaders, bodies  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly distinguishes Adi-Andhra from Adi-Hindu?
o: Adi-Andhra referred to tribal communities of Andhra, while Adi-Hindu referred to Dalits of Madras city.
Adi-Andhra and Adi-Hindu were names exclusively used for the same organisation.
Adi-Andhra referred to Dalits of Hyderabad State, while Adi-Hindu referred to Dalits of coastal Andhra.
Adi-Andhra referred to Dalits of the Andhra region, while Adi-Hindu referred to Dalits of Hyderabad State.
accepted.x: Adi-Andhra referred to Dalits of Andhra, including coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema, whereas Adi-Hindu referred to Dalits of Hyderabad State.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between two closely related regional labels.
accepted.sec: Adi-Andhra and Adi-Hindu movements - sessions, venues, leaders, bodies  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who popularised the terms Adi-Andhra and Adi-Hindu and was regarded as the father of the Dalit movement in Hyderabad and Andhra?

The 1917 resolution of the first Adi-Andhra session included which of the following?
1. Replacement of the term “Panchama” by “Adi Andhra” in the Madras region.
2. Replacement of the term “Panchama” by “Adi Hindu” in Hyderabad.
3. Provision of special schools and wells in Dalit wadas.
4. Reservation of seats in local bodies and councils.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
accepted.x: The 1917 resolution sought the replacement of “Panchama” by regionally appropriate names, representation in local bodies and councils, special schools, and access to wells in Dalit wadas.
accepted.tq: Treat each component of a resolution as an independently testable statement.
